title: CF Meet Telephony common vocabulary v1
description: Provider-neutral vocabulary of public-network execution (Part E). Never a provider name, carrier id, provider call id, SIP Call-ID / dialog id, SIP body, provider payload, carrier status string, trunk credential or telephone number.

TelephonyLegStatus.description: Normalized status of a Telephony execution leg. UNKNOWN is not terminal and never a failure: the provider may or may not have created a paid call; only evidence resolves it.

PublicRouteClass.description: Public-network route classes Telephony executes (Calling's Routing Engine classes; APP_RTC never reaches Telephony). Part F: ENTERPRISE_INTERNAL is an internal dialog of an enterprise SIP device on CF Meet's own edge (no carrier, no provider, no spend, no usage fact).

FailureCategory.description: The same vocabulary as Calling's failure categories.
